title: AI-Driven, Timing-Aware Power Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.18890v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Post-route power recovery changes cell choices under tightly coupled timing, electrical and physical constraints, and the value of each change depends on what it costs to repair its side effects. We propose an AI-driven framework in which a learned model drives both phases of the optimization: it ranks the powerrecovery edits to try and the repair actions that follow, while deterministic electronic design automation (EDA) analyses govern every acceptance. The framework records baseline constraint margins, identifies the damage a recovery transaction introduces in each analysis view, holds pre-existing violations at their baseline rather than working them inside the power step, and caps repair spending at a fraction of the measured saving. An ensemble of gradient-boosted models predicts power change, normalized damage reduction and constraint-regression risk from action and timing-context features available before each trial; calibrated

translated_title: AI驱动的时序感知功耗优化
translated_abstract: 布线后功耗恢复需要在时序、电气和物理约束紧密耦合的情况下改变单元选择，而每次改变的价值取决于修复其副作用所需的成本。我们提出一个AI驱动的框架，其中学习到的模型驱动优化的两个阶段：它对要尝试的功耗恢复编辑以及随后的修复动作进行排序，同时由确定性的电子设计自动化（EDA）分析掌控每一次的接受判定。该框架记录基线约束裕量，识别恢复事务在每个分析视图中引入的损害，将预先存在的违例保持在基线水平而不在功耗优化步骤中处理它们，并将修复开销限制在实测节省量的一小部分之内。一个由梯度提升模型组成的集成模型从每次试验前可获得的动作和时序上下文特征预测功耗变化、归一化损害降低和约束回退风险；经校准的
tldr: 提出了一种AI驱动的时序感知功耗优化框架，利用梯度提升模型集成来排序功耗恢复编辑和修复动作，在EDA确定性分析的把关下实现布线后功耗降低，同时避免引入新的约束违例。
en_tdlr: An AI-driven timing-aware power optimization framework that uses an ensemble of gradient-boosted models to rank power recovery edits and repair actions, achieving post-route power reduction under deterministic EDA analysis while avoiding new constraint violations.
